request.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE independently painted transparent RGBA game animation frame for original pet 符小虎, E-facing cast action, 16 frames at 45 ms. Input 1 is original pet identity; input 2 is ONLY the approved hand-painted material/style reference; input 3 is locked E camera, body scale, seated base, foot contacts, tail and costume. If input4 is present it is previous animation frame; progress from it by one small coherent step.
Preserve the SAME apricot-golden tiger cub, dark brown stripes, cream muzzle/chest/paws, round ears, large brown-gold eyes, pink nose, golden headband with one red-marked yellow forehead talisman, jade-green gold-edged shoulder cape, ONE round golden yin-yang chest bell, exactly two front paws and two hindfeet, and ONE short thick upcurved striped tiger tail rooted from rear (tail screen-left in E). Follow reference 3's true three-quarter FRONT camera facing screen lower-right. Seated tiger, buttocks and two hindfeet supporting fixed on same places; do not turn it into standing human.
Frame composition MUST preserve reference3 canvas framing, scale and positions of body base/hindfeet. One entire character fully inside square canvas with generous transparent margins, no crop. Fixed camera and no global translation, rotation, zoom, recentering or added background. Hand-painted rounded full-bodied clean bright Q-style volume and fur matching inputs1/3, polished jade/ivory/warm-gold material style from input2; no UI or lettering. Single frame only, no grid, no multiple poses, no caption.
Anatomical RIGHT front paw starts from screen-left shoulder; LEFT front paw starts from screen-right shoulder. Same arms throughout: chest gathering uses both, release uses RIGHT crossing forward to lower-right. Keep four limbs anatomically attached and distinguish them from the two permanently grounded hindfeet. No duplicated palms, detached limbs, new props, extra talismans, new jewelry, additional tail, redrawing identity, mirrored character, foot sliding. Magic is only small jade-gold light from existing talisman/bell; not a physical object. True transparent background preserves soft alpha and no dark/white matte.
CRITICAL: when the screen-right LEFT forepaw lifts, its old low white paw beside/between hindfeet MUST DISAPPEAR. There are only FOUR total limb endings: two animated forepaws, two planted padded hindfeet. NEVER retain the low resting forepaw as an extra fifth paw. Current phase: 04/16 — Gather. Both forepaws draw inward in front of the existing chest bell, round paws cup a small empty space. Elbows bent, shoulders lifted just slightly. Head begins lifting, concentrated eyes half-open. No visible energy core yet, only a faint gold glimmer from bell. Keep concentration through an incantation: the little open mouth becomes a smaller O shape, not a big laugh. Edit the immediately previous pose, do not reset to idle.
